2607.14682.title: Stop Thinking, Start Looking: Efficient Post-Training for Multimodal Document Question Answering via Reasoning-Free Alignment
2607.14682.paper_summary: Efficient multimodal document question answering with explicit visual grounding, locating the precise document region that supports each answer remains an open challenge. Current approaches bifurcate into Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), which requires large annotated datasets and reaches optimization plateaus, and reasoning-centric Reinforcement Learning (RL), which depends on verbose intermediate traces that inflate inference token cost without clear benefit. We introduce Perception-RFT, a training framework that applies Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to multimodal document QA, bypassing intermediate reasoning tokens to directly align visual features with structured grounding outputs. To rigorously evaluate the necessity of reasoning, we construct a reasoning variant under identical reward settings. We find that reasoning-enabled models suppress their reasoning traces during training, converging to direct perception-based policies at the 4B parameter scale, reducing per-query inference token length by more than 60%, while reasoning-enabled RL underperforms perception-only training. Through a fine-grained analysis of Qwen3-VL-4B optimization dynamics, we confirm that SFT saturation and cold-start RL instability established in text-domain post-training extend to multimodal, and identify a previously uncharacterized Grounding Divergence: a selective trade-off between semantic robustness and geometric precision on two out of distribution (OOD) benchmarks (4,828 samples) under joint RL optimization. We further show that an early SFT$\rightarrow$RL transition achieves comparable precision with 65% less training data.
2607.14682.paper_summary_zh: 有效的多模態文檔問題回答，明確的視覺基礎，定位支持每個答案的精確文檔區域仍然是一個未解的挑戰。當前的方法分為監督微調（SFT），這需要大量的標註數據集並達到優化平臺，和以推理為中心的強化學習（RL），這依賴於冗長的中間痕跡，增加推理標記的成本而沒有明顯的好處。我們介紹了Perception-RFT，一個訓練框架，將群體相對策略優化（GRPO）應用於多模態文檔QA，繞過中間推理標記，直接將視覺特徵與結構化基礎輸出對齊。為了嚴格評估推理的必要性，我們在相同的獎勵設置下構建了一個推理變體。我們發現，啟用推理的模型在訓練過程中壓制其推理痕跡，在4B參數規模下收斂到基於直接感知的策略，將每查詢推理標記長度減少超過60%，而啟用推理的RL表現不及僅基於感知的訓練。通過對Qwen3-VL-4B優化動態的細緻分析，我們確認SFT飽和和冷啟動RL不穩定性在文本領域後訓練中延伸到多模態，並識別出先前未描述的基礎發散：在聯合RL優化下，對兩個分佈外（OOD）基準（4,828個樣本）在語義穩健性和幾何精確性之間的選擇性權衡。我們進一步顯示，早期的SFT$\rightarrow$RL過渡在減少65%訓練數據的情況下達到了可比的精度。
